content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Walk the Avenue of the Dead and climb the Pyramid of the Sun for a view that outlives empires."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Step into Frida's blue house and feel her world in the paint and the plants."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tacos that prove vegan can be loud, messy and deeply satisfying."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Glide the old canals on a painted trajinera, where the city slows to a paddle's rhythm."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A calm, spice-warm table with halal plates and a welcome pause between canals and farewells."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stand on the great square where the city's layers of stone and story meet the sky."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The castle keeps its crown of history above the treetops, with a view that makes the whole city feel like a mural."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stone gods and feathered serpents wait inside, patient as the centuries."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Bright plates and a room that hums like a Sunday market."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lakes, shade and the slow green breath of the park."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the leafy streets where old mansions now hold cafés and small galleries."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tiny tacos al pastor, carved thin and served fast, the way the city likes them."}]}
A whole trip through my city, from Coyoacán's charm to the pyramids and a proper goodbye downtown — every must-do made it, and I approve.
